title: Run a script staged in /tmp through an interpreter
threat_model: An attacker stages a script in a world-writable temporary directory and runs it with the system's python3.
known_gap: The program that is executed is /usr/bin/python3, and the script is only an argument. exec_from_tmp looks at the executed filename only, so an interpreter running a script from /tmp is not seen.
notes: The script is staged by setup.sh in a unique directory under /tmp (the only scenario that uses /tmp) and removed by teardown.sh. Nothing else in the rules applies to this activity, so no alert is listed as acceptable.
